name: Matthew Browne
profile: Professor Matthew Browne is an academic researcher at Central Queensland University. His research includes computational statistics, modelling in health research, gambling harm, psychometrics, and applied social science. He advises PhD, master's, and honours students in the psychology program. He is co-host of Decoding the Gurus with Chris Kavanagh, Associate Professor of Psychology at Rikkyo University, where they analyse public intellectuals and online influencers through a psychosocial and anthropological lens.
education: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.), Griffith University, Mt Gravatt, Brisbane, Australia, 2002.
Bachelor of Behavioural Science (B.Beh.Sc), first class honours, Griffith University, Mt Gravatt, Brisbane, Australia, 1998.
employment: 2011-present: Professor, School of Health, Human, & Social Sciences, Central Queensland University. Formerly Associate Professor, Senior Lecturer, and Lecturer.
2003-2004: Research Fellow, FhG GMD-JRL - Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft Japan Research Laboratory.
publicEngagement: Co-host of Decoding the Gurus with Chris Kavanagh, Associate Professor of Psychology at Rikkyo University, an educational podcast that analyses public intellectuals and online influencers through a psychosocial and anthropological lens, with particular attention to how they persuade and influence.
